about: Laboratory balances: zero, tare, weigh [--stable], unit, door, power, status. Capacities, readability and the zero range come from each contract's parameters; argument ranges and enums from its input schemas.

excluded.mt_hx204: halogen moisture analyzer: weighing is a step inside its drying measurement (measurement.tare only in an open measurement, balance.indicated_kg a live readout); no free-standing zero, display unit or draft-shield door. Primary class: drying / moisture analysis.
excluded.mt_quantos_q2_xpe206dr: powder dosing system: its XPE206DR balance works only inside a dosing set-up (container position selected, observation model from the host); balance.tare records the dosing baseline and is refused in a plain lab. Primary class: dosing, which can offer zero/tare/weigh in the dosing context.
excluded.ch_chi440c: quartz-crystal microbalance: measures mass change through the crystal frequency; electrochemistry class.
excluded.ta_tga5500: thermogravimetric analyzer: mass is a measured signal of a thermal method; thermal-analysis class.

tare: the terminal Tare key (balance.request) waits up to 40 s for stability by itself; chemlab sends balance.tare once the reading is stable and waits with --wait instead
unit: the terminal display unit (display.set_unit); balance.set_display_unit only switches the weighing-cell label between g and kg
door: the motorised side doors (door.operate); the top door has no motor
the draft-shield doors are moved by hand (doors.set is a physical action); any open door makes the reading unstable
weigh: the PX has no weight query capability: weigh reads its state (the remote SP / IP commands print the same values)

unsupported.door: it is a portable precision balance without a draft shield (no doors)

alternatives.door: nothing to do: an SPX has no doors; shield it from draughts by its position on the bench.

unit: the SPX offers no mg unit (readability 0.1 g); weigh reports mg values computed from grams
